This template is a suggestion, not a requirement. Reword the headings, drop the sections

your change better. A one-line fix does not need four headings.
-->

## What Does This Change?

## How Was It Tested?

<!--
Note that the RTL simulation regression (`gitlab-ci`) does NOT run on pull requests from
forks, so this section is how reviewers know what has actually been simulated.
-->

## Checklist

- [ ] `uv run prek run --all-files` passes locally
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `[Unreleased]` (if user-visible)
- [ ] New files carry a copyright and SPDX license header
- [ ] Tests added or updated for FlooGen changes
- [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable), including the `nav` in `zensical.toml` for new pages
